name: ar-ghost-catcher
description: Mobile-first multiplayer Halloween AR ghost hunt

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/shared && npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/server && npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/web && npm run build -w @ghost-hunt/gateway
scripts.dev:event: concurrently -k -n web,server,gateway -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @ghost-hunt/web" "npm run dev -w @ghost-hunt/server" "npm run dev -w @ghost-hunt/gateway"
scripts.lint: eslint scripts tests && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:event: concurrently -k -n web,server,gateway -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run start -w @ghost-hunt/web" "npm run start -w @ghost-hunt/server" "npm run start -w @ghost-hunt/gateway"
